predecessors.name: Ilkhanate
predecessors.text: Azerbaijan around Tabriz, where the family had served the Ilkhans

successors.name: Golden Horde
successors.text: Tabriz and its district, taken by Jani Beg in the winter of 1356-1357 (the Horde held no other Chobanid land)

ledger.x: 1338: Hasan Kucek defeats the Jalayirids and founds the Chobanid realm around Tabriz.
Late 1338: the peace gives Azerbaijan to Hasan Kuchak.
1339: Pir Husayn Chubani becomes governor of Fars and Isfahan.
1342: the Injuid Abu Ishaq replaces the Chobanids in southern Iran.
1357: the Golden Horde takes Tabriz and Malik Ashraf is executed.

wars.name: Chobanid-Jalayirid war of 1338
wars.outcome: Hasan Kucek beat Hasan Buzurg (16 July 1338, Naushahr); the peace of late 1338 gave Azerbaijan to the Chobanids.

wars.name: Chobanid attack on Baghdad (1347)
wars.outcome: Malik Ashraf's army failed to take Baghdad and retreated by the summer after heavy losses.

wars.name: Chobanid attack on Fars (1350)
wars.outcome: 'He also failed to seize Fars from the Injuids in 1350.'

wars.name: Golden Horde conquest of the Chobanid realm
wars.outcome: The Golden Horde captured Tabriz in 1357, executed Malik Ashraf and carried his family north.

certainty.note: No page gives a treaty line; the Jalayirid frontier at Baghdad and the Injuid frontier in Fars are approximate.
